$comment: Shared input/expected vectors for VfSkeleton. The TypeScript rules in skeleton/state.ts and the PHP mirror in packages/razor/src/Support/SkeletonState.php both run this file. Its own file rather than an addition to presentation/state-vectors.json: a shared vector catalog is exactly how one component's evidence starts standing in for another's.

resolveSkeletonStyle.$why: The default. minHeight is absent, so only the radius token is written.
A numeric minHeight becomes pixels and is written first.
Zero is a length, not an absence.
A string minHeight is passed through untouched.
The quirk: an empty radius drops the declaration rather than meaning zero.
The same quirk on both properties leaves no declarations at all, and therefore no style attribute.
